items.title: The Leading Hotels of the World Unites More Than 400 Independent Hoteliers in Rome for Its 60th Annual Convention
items.snippet: LHW's 60th Annual Convention brought 400+ hoteliers to Rome across six member properties, covering AI, luxury market trends, and traveler expectations, closing with the 2026 Membership Awards.

items.title: The Pressures on Expedia B2B
items.snippet: Skift Take: Expedia's partner business has carried the company's growth for years. A slowdown caused by a tough comparison to last year's fourth quarter would be a blip. One driven by deteriorating economics and potentially a stronger rival in Booking Holdings would be a much larger issue.

items.title: JK Urbanscapes plans INR 965-crore hospitality investment across five destinations
items.snippet: Developer’s 650-key pipeline includes projects with IHCL and Minor Hotels, spanning pilgrimage, heritage, leisure and urban markets JK Urbanscapes Developers Ltd (JKUDL), part of the JK Organisation, is planning an investment of approximately INR 965 crore, including land cost, to develop six hospitality projects across India, with a combined pipeline of nearly 650 keys.

items.title: Another Airline Outage: Delta Struggles With Flight Delays Before Thanksgiving
items.snippet: Delta Air Lines suffered widespread flight delays and cancellations after a weight-and-balance system failure disrupted operations nationwide, adding to aviation technology concerns as millions prepare for Thanksgiving holiday travel.

items.title: Trailborn Hotels & Resorts expands to Yosemite with 3 properties
items.snippet: The outdoor hospitality brand will assume management of Firefall Ranch at the California national park. It will also manage Rush Creek Lodge & Spa and Evergreen Lodge after Castle Peak Holdings acquired both properties.

items.title: Moldova targets Indian wine trade and tourism market
items.snippet: Moldova is exploring opportunities to enter the Indian wine market, with local producers using international trade exhibitions to identify potential importers and distributors. The country is also looking to develop its tourism engagement with India, supported by its diplomatic presence in the market.

Bangladesh Visa centres in Kolkata, Siliguri to close
items.snippet: Bangladesh will suspend visa application-related operations at its existing visa application centres in Kolkata and Siliguri from December 1 after the government decided not to renew its visa outsourcing agreement with DU Digital Global Ltd, which expires on November 30.

items.title: India's food regulator to take Bisleri to court over water quality finding
items.snippet: India's food safety regulator will take Bisleri International, maker of the country's best-known bottled water brand, to court after a sample of its packaged drinking water was found to be unsafe, the regulator said on Sunday.
